title: Cairn folder defaults (folder.yaml), format v1
description: Defaults for every request in this folder and below. The collection root has one too. A deeper level overrides a shallower one; a request overrides both.

vars.description: Variables, as defaults: an environment or a script can override them. They are committed, so keep secrets out.

headers.description: Headers added to every request. A switched-off row removes an inherited header.
